extraction.Name: Maggie Conroy Roubideaux
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 320 acre allotment, for the reason that she did not desire to have taxes to pay; but she was advised by the Pine Ridge Agency, that taxes would be piled against it by the County, and they would finally sell it for same, if she did not take it over and handle it, so she accepted the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her allotment to Maylard Company, of Norfolk, Nebraska, for $750.00, getting this money for improvements, and, in 1926, she paid the mortgage off; that the 320 acres is now back in trust, having been bought with the children's money, in their name, and put back in trust
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Maylard Company of Norfolk, Nebraska for $750.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she has kept her taxes paid up
extraction.Occupation/Income: receives $200.00 per year lease money off of this 320 acre allotment; cooks at Police Headquarters, at Pine Ridge, South Dakota, for which she receives $480.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: Has six children to support, their father being dead; children all have good health; mortgage taken out in 1921 for improvements and paid off in 1926; land put back in trust in children's names with children's money; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; document dated December 1, 1928
